Unavailable dates

Use a date input for dates people know by heart, like a birthday. The value is an ISO date like `"2026-11-02"`, and it stays `null` until every part holds something. Each part fills as you type and moves on, the day is kept within its month, and a whole date can be pasted into any part. For picking from a calendar, use the Date Picker.
`DateInput` renders its parts on its own. Add `DateInputSegments` yourself to put an icon or other content beside them.
`createDateInputController()` sets, clears or focuses the field from anywhere. Focus a part by its unit, like `"year"`.
`granularity` set to `"hour"`, `"minute"` or `"second"` adds the time, and the value becomes a local date and time like `"2026-11-02T14:30"`.
`locale` sets the order and the separators. The digits are always 0 to 9 and the calendar is always Gregorian, so the value means the same date everywhere.
`unavailable` takes ISO dates, `{ from, to }` ranges, weekdays or a function, and a date on one is invalid.
